text:
jamie: Heads-up — PR #4523 turned red on CI. Only integration-7 failed (timeout connecting to redis). Can't repro locally. Can someone retrigger just that shard without forcing image rebuilds? We don't want to lose cached artifacts.

maria: ack. You can run the lightweight retry script: `./scripts/ci_retry --pr 4523 --shard integration-7 --no-build --preserve-cache`

jamie: Is there a GH comment option? CI admins sometimes prefer comment triggers.

maria: yep — comment on the PR: `@ci-bot rerun shard=integration-7 no_build=true preserve_cache=true` (bot will queue a targeted rerun)

alex: alternative if you have GH privileges: Actions -> workflow run -> select run -> "Re-run failed jobs" then cancel image build step if present. slower but works if bot misfires.

samir: if it's flaky due to redis maybe add `CI_RETRY_HTTP=3` env when rerunning to increase client timeout, helped us before.

maria: also do a dry-run first to see which jobs would run: `./scripts/ci_retry --pr 4523 --shard integration-7 --dry-run`

ci-bot: Started targeted rerun for PR #4523 — integration-7 (run_id=rv-98765). No image build, cache preserved. ETA ~3m :rocket:

jamie: thanks — watching logs now. I'll ping if it flakes again. :thumbsup:
